tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search the Vocenya developer docs: guides (authentication, webhooks, pagination, outbound calling rules, live chat, MCP) and every API endpoint. Returns the best matches with their page URL; read one with get_doc_page or get_endpoint.

tools.name: get_doc_page
tools.description: Get one page of the Vocenya developer docs as Markdown, exactly as published. Slugs: "index", a guide like "quickstart", "authentication", "webhooks", "webhook-events", "outbound-calls", "live-chat" or "mcp", "reference" for the API overview, or "reference/leads" for a resource's endpoints. Use sear

tools.name: list_endpoints
tools.description: List the endpoints of the Vocenya REST API with their method, path, summary and required scope, grouped by resource. Pass a tag (resource) like "Leads" or "Webhooks" to list one resource. Get the details of one with get_endpoint.

tools.name: get_endpoint
tools.description: Get one Vocenya API endpoint in full, as Markdown: its scope, path and query parameters, request body, responses, response attributes and code samples in cURL, Node, PHP and Python. Example: method "POST", path "/leads".

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "docs" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_docs, get_doc_page, get_endpoint · Public sink: get_doc_page, get_endpoint.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_docs, get_doc_page, get_endpoint · Public sink: get_doc_page, get_endpoint

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
